assertions: The probe runs on a dedicated emulator or owned probe device, not a daily-use phone, and the user explicitly approves extending the opaque identity to this candidate capability before execution.

The Portal/Appium service is reachable only through an exact loopback origin and no reverse-cloud, APK-install, file, clipboard, notification or streaming feature is enabled by this Connector.
The foreground package equals com.xingin.xhs before every action and any package drift fails closed.
The query 拼豆 is entered once, no pagination or retry is performed, and there are no likes, follows, comments, messages, publication or account changes.

The candidate output retains no coordinates, resource IDs, selectors, raw XML/JSON, runtime route, session ID, token or account identity.
A passed probe verifies only one current Android app version, route and initial visible search surface; comments, trend estimation and corpus completeness remain unverified.
cleanup: Stop the Xiaohongshu app after manual comparison and discard the transient UI tree and any temporary diagnostic screenshot outside Git.
